title: Should Every School Teach Coding?
text:
Proponents of compulsory programming lessons argue that code has become a basic literacy, as essential to modern careers as reading and arithmetic. They contend that children who learn to write algorithms develop logical reasoning that transfers to other subjects. Sceptics, however, question whether a rushed curriculum will produce competent programmers or merely a generation of students who can copy tutorials without understanding them.

The strongest case against a universal requirement, therefore, is not that coding lacks value but that schools lack teachers qualified to teach it well. A poorly delivered course can breed resentment toward technology rather than curiosity about it. Policymakers would do better to invest in teacher training first and make programming an optional pathway until that foundation exists.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what do proponents say children develop by learning to write algorithms?
options: Logical reasoning that transfers to other subjects

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what do schools lack, according to the strongest case against a universal requirement?
options: Qualified teachers to teach coding well
Parents willing to help at home

questions.text: Why might a poorly delivered course breed resentment toward technology?
options: Because students may associate the subject with frustration and failure
Because technology is too expensive for most families
Because computers break down frequently in schools

questions.text: What is the author's position on a universal coding requirement?
options: It should be introduced immediately in all schools
It should be abandoned because coding has no value
It should wait until teacher preparation is adequate

paragraph_translations: يرى مؤيدو دروس البرمجة الإلزامية أن الشيفرة البرمجية أصبحت معرفة أساسية، لا تقل أهمية عن القراءة والحساب في المهن الحديثة. ويؤكدون أن الأطفال الذين يتعلمون كتابة الخوارزميات يطورون تفكيرًا منطقيًا ينتقل إلى مواد دراسية أخرى. أما المشككون فيتساءلون عما إذا كان منهج متسرع سينتج مبرمجين أكفاء، أم مجرد طلاب ينسخون الدروس التعليمية دون أن يفهموها.

ولذلك فإن أقوى حجة ضد إلزامية شاملة ليست أن البرمجة تفتقر إلى القيمة، بل أن المدارس تفتقر إلى معلمين مؤهلين لتدريسها جيدًا. فالمقرر الذي يُقدَّم بشكل ضعيف قد يولّد استياءً من التكنولوجيا بدلًا من الفضول تجاهها. ولذا يُحسن بصانعي السياسات أن يستثمروا أولًا في تدريب المعلمين، وأن يجعلوا البرمجة مسارًا اختياريًا إلى أن تتوفر هذه الأسس.
